name: Hartline Estates
oneLiner: A boutique residential estate agency that sells a handful of homes a year — each one walked, known, and matched to its buyer.
paletteSeed: warm daylight — limewash cream and plaster papers, walnut ink, clay/terracotta accent, olive-sage secondary; the wave's only light-first page; closes on golden hour as a gradual warm grade, never a dark wall (tonal continuity, s35 rule)
typeDirection: Instrument Serif + italic (display voice and hand-annotations — the human register) with Instrument Sans variable (wayfinding, small-caps data) — both OFL, vendored
motionBudget: one scroll-driven CSS-3D scene: a house assembles from floor plan to lit dwelling (walls hinge up, roof folds on, camera orbits from plan view to eye level, windows warm at the end) — transform-only, zero vendored engine (Jolt assessed and rejected: 3D physics simulator, MB-scale WASM, nothing to simulate); pointer-tilt on the hero model is interaction-only; idle motion near zero per the s36 temperament rule; reduced-motion and no-JS serve the assembled house and the full static page
